type: object (`Image`: `imageBytes` + `mimeType` on the Gemini API; `bytesBase64Encoded` or `gcsUri` + `mimeType` on Vertex)
lixpiValue: veoParams.image, set at google-provider.ts:845 for a first-frame request
summary: A single starting image that Veo animates as the first frame of the clip. This is the image-to-video mode.
combines: Supported on: all Veo models, Gemini Developer API and Vertex
Exactly one image; there is no multi-image first-frame mode.
Restricts `personGeneration` to `allow_adult` on Veo 3 and 3.1 families.
Vertex recommends 720p or higher and a 16:9 or 9:16 ratio; other ratios or sizes may be resized or centrally cropped.
Pair with `config.lastFrame` to switch this mode into first-and-last-frame interpolation.
range: Veo 2's model card lists any resolution and aspect ratio up to a 20MB file; no size limit is documented for Veo 3.x on the Gemini API
